# accumulator.CellAccumulator { #healpyxel.accumulator.CellAccumulator }

```python
accumulator.CellAccumulator(use_tdigest=True)
```

Accumulator for a single HEALPix cell.

Maintains streaming statistics for multiple columns plus optional T-Digest
for approximate percentile computation.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |

| [to_dict](#healpyxel.accumulator.CellAccumulator.to_dict) | Convert accumulator state to dictionary for serialization. |
| [update](#healpyxel.accumulator.CellAccumulator.update) | Add observations for a specific column. |

### to_dict { #healpyxel.accumulator.CellAccumulator.to_dict }

```python
accumulator.CellAccumulator.to_dict()
```

Convert accumulator state to dictionary for serialization.

Uses aggressive (raw) TDigest serialization to ensure centroids are
materialized even if percentiles were never queried.

Returns:
    Dict with 'stats' (per-column StreamingStats) and optionally 'tdigests'

